sources.snippet: Polaris-V1 is an efficient 4-billion parameter open-weights reasoning model developed by NitrAI Research. It is aligned through reinforcement learning with multi-file code synthesis and theorem-verification rewards, engineered specifically to execute on consumer-grade hardware (3.2 GB VRAM) with a 1.59M token YaRN context window.
